title: A held landing state for a lane change that needs the operator (ADR-0157 PR 3, stage shadow)
summary: The policy key held_proposals.stage (default shadow), the heldproposal decision and approval record, the ship landing check that holds a protected or pipeline-kind lane change, the operator verb evolve landing approve|reject|list, and a held line in evolve wave status.
acceptance: At shadow the ship records would-hold for a held lane ship and lands it; at enforce it stops with HELD_FOR_OPERATOR and main does not move.
An approval lands only the tree that it names; a rejection stops the ship with HELD_PROPOSAL_REJECTED.

Only the operator verb writes an approval: a guard test closes the callers of heldproposal.WriteApproval, the approvals live under the protected .evolve/landing/, and the verb is a class D dispatch verb.
evolve landing list and evolve wave status show each held cycle.
notes: Route console-manual: it adds a ship gate and edits the landing and the dispatch gate, which are on the fence. It is the brake that the held proposals need, so no lane can build it.
